newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran President Khatami pledges domestic reforms.
newsitem.headline: Iran President Khatami pledges domestic reforms.

text.p: Iranian President Mohammad Khatami on Wednesday said he was determined to carry through wide-ranging domestic reforms in the Islamic republic.
"I have a pact with the people to fulfil my plans," Khatami said in his first major televised interview since being sworn into office on August 4.
Khatami, a moderate Moslem Shi'ite cleric, was elected in a landslide victory last May on expectations that he could herald social and economic freedoms in Iran.
In the interview Khatami backed the introduction of formal political parties in the country -- banned since the 1979 revolution -- and an independent press.
"To provide channels to convey peoples' needs to the state we need organised political parties, social associations and an independent free press," Khatami said.
"The government must eliminate obstacles in ... expanding these institutions," he said.
